nom: The INKEY List Advanced Retinal Serum for Fine lines + Wrinkles

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or eczema-prone skin, including some easing up from a starter retinoid, broadly report little to no irritation and describe visible improvement in fine lines and congestion.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry, eczema-prone skin in her mid-40s reports it fit into her routine without compromising her barrier, leaving skin smoother and brighter within four to six weeks.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal, hormonal acne-prone skin found it a good beginner retinol that helped clear her dark spots.
segments.mature: A 58-year-old reviewer with mature skin reports good results after 18 months of use as part of an otherwise minimal routine.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, smoother texture and a brighter, more even complexion, generally within two to eight weeks of consistent use; a couple of reviewers say they saw no or only a slight difference after several weeks.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the serum as moisturizing rather than drying, even for a retinal; a few report mild dryness during the first one to two weeks that settled on its own or was managed by switching to a richer moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report little to no redness, burning or peeling, including several experienced retinoid users who compare it favorably to stronger formulas that usually cause more irritation for them.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers specifically note the serum did not compromise their skin barrier, describing their barrier as staying calm or even improving alongside visible results.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it for dark spots and post-acne marks report gradual lightening over two to several weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report improved acne or no new breakouts, including one whose photos showed reduced acne alongside smoother, brighter skin.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight texture absorbs quickly without pilling
Distinct yellow tint, more noticeable with overuse
Recent price increase frustrates returning buyers
Very affordable relative to comparable retinal serums
Thick, creamy consistency despite being called a serum
Small tube size relative to the price

extraits.texte: Shame it didn't work, no improvement on face, after using it for 4 weeks.

I have been trying this for a couple of weeks and to be honest, I don't think I notice a huge difference. It helped my texture a bit, but I have tried others with better results. However, for this price, I think it is a good option.

This is truly sensitive skin heaven! I started with the starter retinoid after eight months of highly reactive skin and it was incredible. So I moved on to this and it is just as good. Zero reaction from my sensitive and eczema pro skin and it actually has left my skin a feeling incredibly soft, congestion significantly reduced and it is blasting my fine lines! Please bring out an eye cream!

extraits.titre: The search for my retinal is over!!!
extraits.texte: This is the best retinal I have ever tried and trust me I have tried and spend money on a lot of retinal creams ! I have dry, eczema prone skin and in my mid 40s I use an array of products (vitamin c, PDRN, Azelaic Acid, Exosomes) on my attempt to give my skin the support it needs so I can age gracefully without invasive procedures! This retinal fitted seamlessly in my night routine without compromising my barrier or causing irritation! But what I love the most within a sort period of time (a month to 6 weeks ) I saw real results! My skin was smoother and brighter while my barrier was equally happy! I absolutely love it and I am sticking with it!!

This is a really nice retinol for beginners. I've been incorporating it into my routine slowly, every other day with a hydrating moisturizer. Honestly can't beat the price and I can already tell the difference in my skin. I have normal hormonal acne prone skin and this is a perfect addition to help clear my dark spots

This actually works! After a few weeks, I am starting to see visible results. I have dark spots and some fine lines. I'm 30 years old and my skin is starting to age. I used this for a few weeks and I see that my fine lines are getting smoother and dark spots are slowly lightening. Excited to keep using it!
